parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss Z format. A time zone offset is required, such as 2023-07-20 09:00:13 +0800. Note: This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns a 400 error. The start time must be within the last 7 days. If the time is out of range, the API returns a 400 error with the message "startDate is not within 7 days"
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。具体格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss Z（必须携带时区偏移，例如 2023-07-20 09:00:13 +0800）。注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误；且 StartDate 必须为距今 7 天内的日期，超出范围 API 返回 400 错误（提示 startDate is not within 7 days）
